captions.detailed: A square-housed industrial box fan in black, mounted to a grey wall bracket. The fan features a central spinning blade assembly behind a simple grid grille, a side-mounted oscillation knob, and a front-facing speed control knob. The main housing can pan left and right on a vertical joint connected to the wall bracket, while the blade spins continuously and both knobs can rotate on their shafts.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a wall-mounted box fan with a square black housing, a rear grey wall bracket, and a central fan blade. Incorporate a continuous rotation joint for the fan blades, a revolute joint for the housing to pan relative to the wall bracket, and continuous rotation joints for both the side oscillation knob and front speed knob.
captions.factory: Construct the wall bracket using box primitives. Model the main fan housing as a hollowed-out box with an internal grid of rectangular bars. Create the fan blades by extruding angled profiles around a central cylinder hub. Define the control knobs as small cylinders. Assemble the parts with four joints: a revolute joint connecting the bracket to the housing, a continuous joint for the fan blade, and two continuous joints for the side and front knobs.
